ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (off-white/cream) in central lobe regions and 25% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) concentrated at the periphery and midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity blobs occupy the central-medial area of both lobes. These are bordered by low-intensity bands at the distal tips and trailing edges. A vertical low-intensity band bisects the fluke at the peduncle junction. High-frequency dark linear streaks are mapped across the primary high-intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography; frequent jagged peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) create a continuous serrated boundary from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the upper trailing edge leading to acute, upward-tapering tips; the lower margin exhibits a broad convex sweep from the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) located exclusively on the outermost terminal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented in multiple non-parallel vectors across the ventral surface of both lobes, contrasting sharply against the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; multiple irregular notches and chips along the trailing edge boundary; pervasive surface scratching consistent with rake mark scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, low-intensity circular ring-shaped mark is visible in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe's high-intensity region.
